notes: Nine retained guidance skills from Claude-Cortex plus 29 ECC agent/eval workflow skills projected under MARK-242.

The plugin is the custody home for the imported seed, follow-on architecture skills, the MARK-204 contract-doctrine slice, the MARK-205 OpenAPI companion slice, the MARK-210 security-framing slice, and the MARK-242 ECC agent/eval workflow skills.
Later Claude-Cortex candidates beyond the imported custody skills remain out of scope.
ECC skills beyond the 29 agent/eval workflow skills projected under MARK-242 remain out of scope.
